hypothesis: Two thresholds on the same measured variable, resolver and observation timestamp may violate their deterministic implication ordering at executable depth; passive entry on one leg may preserve enough spread to survive doubled fees and immediate orphan reserve.

certification.comparator_normalization: strict and inclusive operators remain distinct unless endpoint precision proves equivalence
certification.payoff_identity: for K_low < K_high, buy YES(low) plus NO(high); every valid terminal state pays at least one dollar per equal-share bundle

execution.taker_control: walk complete displayed ask depth on both legs; equal shares; current fee schedule at 2x; FOK feasibility
execution.passive_arm: join one best bid behind full displayed queue; cancellations give no queue credit; public trade-through consumes queue; immediately cross the other leg after each partial fill
execution.non_atomicity: reserve the worst executable unwind loss for every possible non-empty proper filled subset
execution.qualification: worst-state payout - complete entry cost - doubled fees - orphan reserve >= $0.05 at <=$10 deployed capital

evaluation.null_outcome: Certified logical anomalies may be too rare, too shallow or too expensive to execute profitably.
